data.action: 蹲在水池前手握纸网小心捞金鱼，浴衣下摆微收，呆毛竖直，神情极度专注
data.camera: medium close-up, low angle looking across water, intimate depth
data.description: 【丛雨 · 夏日祭捞金鱼的执着对决】热闹非凡的穗织夏日祭典红灯笼长街上，丛雨蹲在水流潺潺的捞金鱼水池边。她身穿深红金鱼花纹浴衣，手里拿着已经有些破损的纸网，全神贯注地屏住呼吸盯着水里游动的一条绯红小金鱼。头顶的大呆毛因为紧张而笔直竖起，娇憨认真的模样惹人无限怜爱。
data.lighting: 头顶红色祭典灯笼洒下的浓艳暖光与水面反光
data.location: 夏日祭典红灯笼小吃长街水池摊前
data.promptProse: Murasame crouches at the festival goldfish basin in her scarlet patterned yukata and dark-red obi, holding a partly torn paper scoop as she watches a red fish with intense concentration. Her upright ahoge stays above the low medium close-up across the water. Red lanterns hang over the stall behind. Their warm reflections move along the basin and her fingertips, contrasting with the darker water beneath the swimming fish.
data.title: 丛雨 · 夏日祭捞金鱼的执着对决
